name: blockchain-trade-bot
description: Six-agent, fail-closed stock and crypto research desk with offline paper simulation, transparent risk gates and immutable-style audit receipts. No real trading tools or wallet access.

interface.longDescription: Research-first six-agent workflow for stocks and crypto with deterministic handoffs: Scout, Filter, Analyst, Risk, Executor, Logger. Ships an offline $50 paper portfolio engine, Binance public read-only snapshot collector, risk and data-quality gates, kill log and SHA-256-chained event receipts. Can describe integration patterns for NautilusTrader, HyperGrok and NVIDIA-derived skill governance, but does not include a live broker, API wallet, hosted service, always-on worker, or live trade execution. No profits are promised.
defaultPrompt: Blockchain-Trade-Bot: Run the $50 paper-trading risk checklist with six agents.
Audit a proposed stock or crypto trade; report every failing gate.
Explain the overnight read-only monitor and validation plan.
